source_facts.fact: publishReadSnapshot copies the full occupancy<double> + inflated<char> + fixed<char> when observation/epoch changes; full distance<double> on distance revision/epoch changes.
Completed snapshot is published before a next fusion when occupancy callback drains a ready async result; writer also publishes after each callback at line756.
recordESDFTiming ends before immutable snapshot publication, so pipeline main_commit_ms and job snapshot_ms do not measure full-map snapshot copies.
Adaptive split needs at least2 regions and 15% gain; otherwise exact dense EDT remains. regions=1/computed=input_bound in current logs proves this fallback is exercised.

logical_copy_bytes_per_changed_generatio.caveat: logical copied bytes, not measured elapsed time or additional resident bytes. Fixed-layer copies are redundant when static layer is unchanged, but changing sharing/layout is a separate implementation choice.

findings: Independent exporter output remains fast; if measured h17-to-receive remains low, another output timer change is not supported.

Actual worker compute averages and dense input size are measured. Single-region 2.2M+ voxel EDT despite only hundreds of changed cells dominates named map pipeline stages; this is the first evidence-backed compute target.
Full immutable publication has no dedicated timing. It can add unaccounted cost between commit and exporter acquisition, but this recording cannot prove its contribution.
No TTL relaxation or source-time renewal is justified. Keep complete-generation and live-health gates.

The overall window contains a later arm_stop_latched interval. Use before_first_arm_stop for healthy-actuator map-age distribution; the large multi-second overall max is not evidence of normal exporter latency.

minimal_next_step.recommendation: Before editing storage architecture, add targeted elapsed accounting for publishReadSnapshot occupancy/distance copy and completed-generation publish time, or benchmark the existing worker on a captured immutable occupancy job. Current evidence already supports dense EDT as a real cost; it does not support claiming full-copy is the dominant cause.
minimal_next_step.possible_small_equivalent_worker_improve: Consider fast paths for trivial all-zero/all-MAX intermediate EDT lines only after exact equivalence/benchmark; whether these occur frequently in this real scene is not recorded. Do not change distance cap, halos, tile coverage or TTL just to meet the deadline.

before_first_arm_stop.limitation: Reference was already cancelled; this is not active-navigation evidence. Separate from subsequent arm_stop_latched/sensor degeneration.

before_first_arm_stop_producer_health_va.selection: Before first arm_stop_latched AND snapshot header[4]==1. Producer mapReadyForPlanning includes real live-LiDAR health and Complete-map/state/geometry gates; this is not an independent raw LiDAR source-age measurement.
